derivation: from H2808 (חֶשְׁבּוֹן) and H3050 (יָהּ); thought of Jah;
def: Chashabnejah, the name of two Israelites

occurrences.text: Then the Levites, Jeshua, and Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabniah, Sherebiah, Hodijah, Shebaniah, and Pethahiah, said, Stand up and bless the Lord your God for ever and ever: and blessed be thy glorious name, which is exalted above all blessing and praise.
